**Über uns**
 Die OPITZ CONSULTING Deutschland GmbH ist Partner für digitale Transformation – mit über 400 Kolleginnen und Kollegen, für Unternehmen vom Mittelstand bis zum DAX\-Konzern. Dabei sind wir bewusst anders geblieben: kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und eine Kultur, in der Menschen wichtiger sind als Organigramme.
   

  

 Im Bereich Data \& AI gestalten wir die nächste Generation datengetriebener Lösungen – von Lakehouse\-Architekturen bis zu Agentensystemen, die Prozesse automatisieren. Die Rolle des Data \& AI Engineers entwickelt sich dabei zunehmend Richtung AI\-Engineering. Du musst nicht heute schon alles können – wichtiger ist uns deine Neugier.
   

  

 Wenn du Lust hast, mit modernen Data\- und AI\-Technologien zu arbeiten und deine Ideen einzubringen, bist du bei uns genau richtig.
   

  

**Das machst du**
 Als (Senior) Data \& AI Engineer (all genders) gestaltest du unsere Analytics\- und KI\-Projekte aktiv mit und entwickelst sie fachlich und technologisch weiter. Dabei begleitest du unsere Kunden von der klassischen Datenplattform bis zur produktiven GenAI\-Anwendung.
   

  

* Lösungsentwicklung \& Beratung: Du konzipierst und entwickelst auf Basis aktueller Methoden und Technologien auftragsbezogene Analytics\- und KI\-Lösungen, die auf die individuellen Anforderungen unserer Kunden zugeschnitten sind.
* Anforderungsanalyse \& Umsetzung: Du strukturierst und priorisierst fachliche Anforderungen und überführst sie in tragfähige technische Lösungen – einschließlich KI\-gestützter Use Cases.
* Data Engineering \& Architektur: Du entwickelst Datenintegrations\- und Datenverarbeitungsprozesse, klassische Data\-Warehouse\-Systeme sowie hybride Architekturen wie Data Lakehouses auf Basis der Medallion\-Architektur.
* AI Engineering \& GenAI: Du reicherst Daten mit KI an, beispielsweise durch LLM\-basierte Klassifikation, Entity Extraction, Embeddings und Vector Search, und schaffst damit die Grundlage für GenAI\- und Agenten\-Use\-Cases.
* Datenmodellierung \& Analytics: Du modellierst und bereitest Daten für Reporting\-, Analyse\- und KI\-Anwendungen sowie für RAG\-Pipelines auf und unterstützt die Visualisierung mit Power BI, Pyramid Analytics oder Databricks.
* Produktivbetrieb \& Governance: Du überführst Modelle und KI\-Pipelines mit Technologien wie MLflow in den Produktivbetrieb und sorgst mit Unity Catalog für Nachvollziehbarkeit und Governance.


**Das bringst du mit**
* Ausbildung \& Projekterfahrung: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im naturwissenschaftlichen oder technologischen Bereich sowie mindestens drei Jahre einschlägige Projekterfahrung in der IT – idealerweise im Consulting\-Umfeld.
* Data Engineering \& Modellierung: Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung, im Aufbau moderner Analytics\-Architekturen sowie in der Datenintegration und Datenverarbeitung.
* Databricks \& Cloudplattformen: Du bringst fundierte Projekterfahrung mit Databricks mit. Kenntnisse in Azure oder AWS sowie weiteren Cloud\-Datenplattformen wie Snowflake sind von Vorteil.
* Technologien \& Datenbanken: Du arbeitest sicher mit SQL und idealerweise mit Python. Zudem kennst du relationale oder multidimensionale Datenbanken wie Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, Exasol oder PostgreSQL sowie Datenintegrations\- und Streaming\-Technologien wie Apache Kafka.
* Analytics \& Methodik: Du hast Erfahrung mit Anforderungsanalysen sowie mit der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Reporting\-, Analyse\- und Dashboard\-Lösungen. Agile Vorgehensmodelle sind dir vertraut.
* GenAI \& Kommunikation: Erste Kenntnisse in LLMs, Embeddings, Vector Databases, RAG\-Architekturen oder Agenten\-Frameworks wie Databricks Mosaic AI, LangChain oder Azure OpenAI Service sind ein Plus. Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse und bist bei Bedarf für Workshops oder Kundentermine reisebereit.


**Unsere Benefits**
* Arbeitszeit \& Hybridmodell: Flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne Kernarbeitszeit und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Homeoffice\-Anteil – für maximale Flexibilität, abgestimmt auf deine Projekte, Kundentermine und dein Team.
* Weiterbildung \& OC\|Academy: 12 Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr für Trainings, Konferenzen und Zertifizierungen. Zugang zur OC\|Academy sowie Kostenübernahme für anerkannte IT\-Zertifikate.
* Community \& Netzwerk: Lerngruppen, Tech Sessions und Community Days für fachlichen Austausch mit erfahrenen IT\-Consultants und Expert:innen.
* Teamkultur \& Zusammenarbeit: Offene und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe, klare Kommunikation und kurze Entscheidungswege – in einem Umfeld, in dem du dich fachlich einbringen und aktiv mitgestalten kannst.
* Gesundheit \& Vorsorge: 6 Monate volle Lohnfortzahlung im Krankheitsfall, aufgestockte betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie Zuschuss zu EGYM Wellpass.
* Mobilität: Firmenwagen mit Fokus auf E\-Mobilität, bis zu 2 Jobfahrräder und Mobilitätszuschuss, zum Beispiel für das Deutschlandticket.
* Familie \& Unterstützung: Kindergartenzuschuss, Geburten\- und Heiratszuschuss sowie bis zu 4 zusätzliche bezahlte Kinderkranktage.
* Empfehlungen, Jubiläen \& Benefits: Prämien für Mitarbeiterempfehlungen, Jubiläumszuwendungen sowie attraktive Mitarbeiterangebote über unser Corporate\-Benefits\-Programm.

**About Us** 

  





  




 PAJ is a leading manufacturer, distributor, and consultant in the field of GPS tracking, headquartered in Windeck\-Hurst. We offer GPS trackers for almost every application. PAJ is a highly dynamic and growing company with many creative and dedicated people, both within and outside of Germany. An open communication culture and great personalities are what make us who we are. If you love variety and challenges, then you belong with us!
 
  





  




 Learn more at: https://www.paj\-gps.com/careers/
 
  





  




**What Makes Us Special** 

  





  




* **Dynamic \& flat hierarchies:** 
 Short decision\-making paths, fast decisions.
* **Family atmosphere:** 
 A warm, supportive team.
* **Active involvement:** 
 Your voice matters. Actively help shape our solutions
* **Varied tasks:** 
 An exciting workday with growing opportunities
* **Support for further development:** 
 Outstanding performance is rewarded with development opportunities
* **Flexible working:** 
 Hybrid – on\-site when needed.
* **Job type:** 
 Full\-time



  





  





  




**About the Role** 

  





  




 We are looking for a hands\-on IT professional who uses AI as a core working tool. You will run and improve our IT infrastructure, support our employees, and solve complex technical problems faster and better by working with modern AI assistants and agents. You are as comfortable directing an AI agent through a configuration as you are plugging in cables on\-site.
 
  





  




**Key Responsibilities** 

  





  




* Plan, set up, and maintain our network infrastructure across sites, including routers, switches, Wi\-Fi, and firewalls (e.g. UniFi).
* Design and manage resilient internet connectivity with multiple providers and automatic failover (e.g. satellite internet with a fixed\-line or mobile backup).
* Segment networks to separate different user groups and areas, such as office, guest, and residential networks.
* Use AI to analyse complex existing setups and create clear graphical network plans and documentation as a basis for on\-site work.
* Configure systems with AI agents (including computer\-use agents), supervising their work and verifying the results.
* Troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues systematically, test changes thoroughly, and track down remaining errors after rollout.
* Provide first\- and second\-level IT support to employees, using AI to resolve issues faster and build reusable solutions.
* Set up and manage computers, user accounts, and workplace IT equipment.
* Identify and implement AI and automation solutions that make our IT and business processes more efficient.
* Ensure IT security and compliance: review AI\-generated configurations, protect access credentials, keep backups, and be able to roll back changes.



  





  





  




**Your Profile** 

  





  




* **Strong, practical AI skills (required):** 
 you use AI assistants and agents daily for technical work, including documentation, analysis, and hands\-on system configuration, and can show concrete examples of problems you solved with them.
* Solid experience in network administration, IT administration, or IT support.
* Good networking knowledge: IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, routing, VPN, multi\-WAN and failover. Experience with UniFi, Starlink, or similar systems is a plus.
* Ability to quickly understand complex, grown infrastructures and turn them into a clear overview.
* Good knowledge of hardware, operating systems, and common business software.
* A critical, security\-conscious mindset: you know when to trust AI output, when to verify it, and how to undo a change safely.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and an independent, hands\-on way of working, including on\-site work at our locations.
* Fluent in German and English, written and spoken.
* Nice to have: driver’s license.

--------------


Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard.


Software \& Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt.

* Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht.

------------------


Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo: ein kleiner, bildschirmfreier KI\-Freund, der Kindern zwischen 4 und 9 ihre Warum\-Fragen beantwortet. Der Prototyp funktioniert, der Launch ist 2027\. Jetzt brauchen wir jemanden, der Onoo in die Köpfe und Wohnzimmer von Eltern bringt.

Was dich erwartet: ein Hardware\-Produkt plus Abo, Direktvertrieb in DACH und Eltern als Zielgruppe, die das Beste für ihre Kinder wollen und Datenschutz ernst nehmen. Und ein Thema, bei dem KI und Kinder in einem Satz stehen. Da gewinnt, wer Vertrauen aufbauen kann.

**Wie du uns helfen kannst**
----------------------------

* Du machst aus Onoo eine Marke, die Eltern sofort verstehen: Positionierung, Story, Ton – vom Video bis zum Karton.
* Du baust unsere UGC\-Maschine: Creator finden, briefen, Hooks schreiben, jede Woche 10–20 Ad\-Varianten testen, lernen, wiederholen.
* Du bringst 5\.000 Familien auf die Warteliste, bevor es Onoo zu kaufen gibt – und hältst sie bei Laune (Newsletter, Social, „Kinderfrage des Tages“).

* Du 5\+ Jahre Consumer\-Marketing gemacht hast, am liebsten D2C mit Abo oder Hardware.
* Du schon mal eine Marke von null aufgebaut hast oder beim Aufbau ganz vorne dabei warst.

* Du KI\-Tools für Content täglich nutzt und weißt, wo ihre Grenze ist.
* Du Kinder, Eltern und Bildung spannend findest. Nicht nur als Zielgruppe.
* Du Verantwortung willst, bevor alles fertig ist.


Eher nicht, wenn: du zuletzt vor allem Budgets und Agenturen gesteuert hast und nicht mehr selbst Hand anlegen willst. Oder wenn du nur Performance kannst, aber keine Marke. Oder nur Marke, aber keine Zahlen.

### **Mid\-Market Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) \- (41k€ Fix, 60k€ OTE)**

### **Über die Firma**


SoSafe zählt zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Cyber\-Security\-Unternehmen Europas. Das 2018 gegründete Unternehmen unterstützt heute über 5\.000 Unternehmen in 37 Ländern dabei, menschliche Cyberrisiken nachhaltig zu reduzieren. Mit mehr als 500 Mitarbeitenden und einer klaren internationalen Wachstumsstrategie bietet SoSafe ein dynamisches, globales Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Entwicklungspotenzial.


Das Ziel von SoSafe ist es, einer der führenden Anbieter für Human Risk Management zu werden. Die KI\-gestützte Awareness\-Plattform hilft Unternehmen dabei, durch interaktive Trainings, Phishing\-Simulationen und verhaltenswissenschaftliche Ansätze eine nachhaltige Sicherheitskultur aufzubauen und Cyberrisiken langfristig zu minimieren.


Cyberkriminalität verursacht weltweit jährlich Schäden in Billionenhöhe und zählt zu den größten wirtschaftlichen Risiken unserer Zeit. Werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das an einer der relevantesten Herausforderungen unserer digitalen Zukunft arbeitet und Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, sich wirksam gegen Cyberangriffe zu schützen.

### **Deine Benefits**

* Schnelle Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten und gutes Training, um dich vom SDR zum Account Executive weiterzuentwickeln.
* Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Tagen Homeoffice pro Woche
* Well\-being und finanzielle Unterstützung: Zugang zur Open\-Up App, Mitarbeiterrabatte
* 33 Urlaubstage

### **So sieht dein Alltag als SDR aus**


Als SDR bist du für die Ansprache von potentiellen Neukunden sowie deren Qualifizierung zuständig und arbeitest eng mit dem gesamten Salesteam zusammen. Sie suchen jemanden, der die Huntermentalität mit der richtigen Energie vereint und bereit ist, kreative Akquisemethoden wie Video\-Outreach und Social Selling zu nutzen.

* Als Sales Development Representative nimmst du zu wichtigen Entscheidungsträger\*innen im IT\-Sicherheitsbereich Kontakt auf und generierst sowie qualifizierst wertvolle Leads.
* Du sicherst die Kundengewinnung durch gezielte Email Ansprache und Social Selling.
* Du bist für die aktive, telefonische Ansprache sowie Betreuung potenzieller Neukund\*innen verantwortlich.
* Du setzt kreative, „out of the box Sales\-Taktiken ein, um deine Pipeline kontinuierlich auszubauen.
* Du präsentierst unser SaaS\-Produkt sowohl am Telefon, in Online\-Meetings als auch auf Events direkt bei Kund\*innen.
* Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Account Executives zusammen, um neue Kund\*innen erfolgreich zu gewinnen.

### **Dein Profil**

* Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung im B2B Outbound Sales gesammelt
* Du bist offen für Feedback, lernbereit und motiviert, dich ständig weiterzuentwickeln
* Du bleibst auch unter Druck organisiert und verfolgst deine Ziele fokussiert
* Du fühlst dich wohl in einem schnelllebigen, dynamischen Umfeld mit schnellen Entscheidungswegen und wenig starren Prozessen
* Du bringst ein Growth Mindset mit und gibst nicht auf, wenn’s mal herausfordernd wird – du willst dich weiterentwickeln!

### **Standort: Köln, hybrid (3 Tage Office pro Woche)**

Vollzeit, Festanstellung

* Montag bis Freitag


Sonderzahlung:

* Provision

* Deutsch auf C2\-Niveau (Erforderlich)
* Englisch auf mind. B2\-Niveau (Erforderlich)

**Job Summary**
 The
 **Head of Supply Planning** 
 is responsible for the leadership and coordination of production planning, procurement, and supply planning project activities within the production plant. The role
 **directly manages a team of two** 
 , while overseeing operational planning topics and developing and executing comprehensive strategies for production scheduling, capacity management, inventory management, and procurement.
   

  

 The Head of Supply Planning works closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure the seamless integration of supply chain activities and the optimal utilization of resources..
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Procurement Planning** 
 :
   

  

* Develop and implement integrated procurement plans that align with production objectives and overall business goals in quality, agility, and cost optimization.
* Ensure seamless synchronization between production plans and procurement activities.
* Keep OTIF (On time in full) performance sustainably at target through internal and external collaboration, operating discipline, and structural improvement activities.
* Ensure reliable supply of strategic electronic components centrally procured by L\-Acoustics for the first level suppliers of L\-Acoustics. Establish and monitor safety stock targets for these strategic electronic components.


**Production Scheduling**
* Collaborate with production and operations teams to build optimized production schedules based on demand forecasts, inventory targets, and procurement timelines.
* Monitor and adjust production schedules to address changes in demand or supply chain dynamics.


**Inventory Optimization**
* Implement comprehensive inventory management strategies to optimize stock levels across the site.
* Manage inventory to minimize carrying costs and avoid overstock situations.
* Manage last\-time\-buy planning and stock management for end\-of\-life electronic components
* Build and follow action plans to eliminate non\-performing inventory
* Participate in periodical stock audit activities of the site


**Supply Planning Team Leadership**
* Provide leadership to the supply planning team, ensuring the timely and cost\-effective sourcing of components.
* Collaborate with the Purchasing department from a planning point of view, supporting their commercial discussions with suppliers.
* Lead and coach the team, fostering a collaborative and results\-driven work environment. Attract best\-in\-class planning talent by establishing a positive and productive culture.
* Conduct performance evaluations and provide ongoing training and development opportunities.


**Lead Time Management**
* Manage and optimize lead times for procurement \& production.
* Coordinate with suppliers and logistics partners to ensure on\-time and in\-full deliveries and minimize disruptions.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with internal cross\-functional teams and also with global supply planning, and supply operation department to ensure effective communication and coordination.
* Collaborate with the Industrial Director to align supply planning activities with overall production objectives.


**Technology Utilization**
* Implement and leverage advanced production planning and procurement tools and technologies to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
* Stay informed about emerging technologies that can improve both production planning and procurement processes.


**Performance Metrics**
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of the supply planning and procurement functions.
* Analyze performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the production planning and procurement teams and across the broader organization.
* Implement process enhancements based on feedback, data analysis, and changing business requirements.


**Risk Management**
* Identify and mitigate risks related to supply chain disruptions, demand variability, and procurement challenges.
* Develop and implement contingency plans to address potential supply and procurement\-related challenges.

Wir machen das Leben der Menschen einfacher und sicherer, überall auf der Welt. Vielfalt ist das Herzstück unseres Unternehmens – und wir schätzen jeden einzelnen unserer klugen und kreativen Köpfe. Wir ermutigen jeden, sich bei der Arbeit voll und ganz einzubringen, und fördern so ein Umfeld, in dem Inspiration, Fachwissen und persönliches Wachstum gedeihen können. Unser gemeinsames Ziel? Wir wollen Großes erreichen und innovative, positive Veränderungen anstoßen \- nicht nur innerhalb der Automatisierungsbranche, sondern auch über deren Grenzen hinaus. Im Gegenzug legen wir großen Wert darauf, eine unterstützende, fördernden und fürsorgliche Umgebung für alle zu schaffen.

Von wettbewerbsfähigen Gehaltspaketen über flexible Arbeitszeiten bis hin zu beruflichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten \- wir wollen einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz für die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden bieten. Es ist uns wichtig, die harte Arbeit und das Engagement unserer Mitarbeitenden anzuerkennen und zu würdigen, und unsere Zusatzleistungen spiegeln dies wider. Unser Ziel ist es, einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an dem sich unsere Mitarbeitenden wertgeschätzt, motiviert und inspiriert fühlen, ihr Bestes zu geben. Sei dabei und profitiere davon, Teil eines Teams zu sein, dem das Wohl und Wachstum seiner Mitarbeitenden am Herzen liegt.

 Der Kern unserer Überzeugung liegt darin, einander mit Freundlichkeit, Aufgeschlossenheit und gegenseitigem Respekt zu begegnen, mit dem Ziel, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich alle befähigt fühlen, ihr authentisches Selbst bei der Arbeit einzubringen. KUKA ist ein Unternehmen, das sich für Chancengleichheit einsetzt. Jede Bewerbung wird bei uns mit Sorgfalt und Bedacht behandelt \- ohne Rücksicht auf deine Herkunft, deinen Bildungshintergrund, dein Alter, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung oder deine religiösen oder politischen Überzeugungen. Wenn du bei KUKA einsteigst, bieten wir dir viele Möglichkeiten, deine Motivation und Individualität einzubringen.
   

  

**Gehe mit uns auf die Reise!**
 Wenn du dir vorstellen kannst, dass eine Karriere bei KUKA das Richtige für dich sein könnte, würden wir uns freuen, von dir zu hören.

**Background:**

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.


The Strategy, Planning, Results and Effectiveness Division (SPRED) is responsible for integrating corporate strategy, resources, and performance management to improve decision\-making and ensure that UN Women manages for results in delivering on its Strategic Plan, while increasing transparency and accountability to its governing bodies and stakeholders. The Division monitors and reports on corporate results and budget implementation to ensure coherent achievement of results in line with the UN Women Strategic Plan.


The Strategic Planning Unit (SPU) in SPRED supports and guides UN Women to achieve higher quality development results through an integrated approach that links strategic planning, monitoring and reporting and Results\-Based Management (RBM). SPU is the custodian of RBM in UN Women. SPU is also the leading unit as business owner for UN Women results management systems to support strategic planning and results\-based monitoring and reporting processes as well as data aggregation and analysis to communicate on results with stakeholders.


As mandated by the UN Women Executive Board, UN Women produces an Executive Director’s Annual Report to demonstrate achievements under its Strategic Plan. Complementing this, UN Women is committed to leveraging global data systems, the Transparency Portal, and the International Aid Transparency Initiative (IATI) to enhance accountability and transparency. Preparations for the development of the next Strategic Plan 2026\-2029 are underway, accompanied by the Integrated Resources and Results Framework to ensure comprehensive alignment between resources and results.


Under the direct supervision of the Strategic Planning Specialist, the Data Analysis and Monitoring Specialist is responsible for consolidating, aggregating, analyzing quantitative and qualitative data of Strategic Plan at the corporate/headquarters (HQ) level to contribute to the corporate level monitoring and reporting on the implementation of UN Women’s Strategic Plan. The Data Analysis and Monitoring Specialist systematically captures Strategic Plan data, allowing UN Women to monitor cumulative progress and achievement of results and targets as outlined in the Strategic Plan results frameworks. They provide technical support to field offices and HQ to strengthen UN Women’s capacity on data collection and analysis. They are also responsible for using key findings form data analysis to strengthen UN Women’s results communication within and beyond UN Women.


**Key Functions and Accountabilities:**

**Strengthen and conduct data collection and analysis to support systematic monitoring and reporting on results and financial data of UN Women’s Global Strategic Plan at the corporate level:**

* Contribute to the development of the Strategic Plans of UN Women, and, in particular, support the development, and any necessary adjustments during the Mid\-Term Review of the UN Women’s Strategic Plan, of the Integrated Results and Resources Frameworks from a data and results perspective internally and with partner UN agencies, ensuring overall quality and meeting corporate deadlines and requirements with the Executive Board.
* Oversee and provide technical guidance to the development, finalization and implementation of data collection/analysis plan per Strategic Plan indicator for systematic monitoring and reporting of UN Women Strategic Plan Integrated Results and Resources Framework in collaboration with various units of HQ and field offices of UN Women and key partners.
* Lead the development of approaches and tools to better quantify and report on UN Women results in a systematic manner and to link with Strategic Development Goals (SDG) targets and indicators.
* Design and conduct data collection methods, including (but not limited to) survey and questionnaires, to collect necessary quantitative and qualitative date at the corporate level.
* Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends and provide overview of performance.
* Coordinate with HQ units, under the leadership of the Policy, Programme and Intergovernmental Division (PPID) Directorate and the Corporate Performance and Accountability Unit (CPAU in SPRED), to oversee in a timely manner the validation of the quality of data collected from the field and HQ levels (baseline, targets, actual monitoring data) before using those for corporate monitoring, review and reporting exercises.
* Provide customized technical support and address gaps in those Strategic Plan indicators whose data collection and analysis methodologies need improvement.
* Collect, aggregate and analyze both qualitative and quantitative data on results from the field and HQ on UN Women Strategic Plans through results management systems and online platforms of UN Women and beyond, and summarize and present key findings to the field and HQ of UN Women to feed into monitoring, reporting and next cycle of planning of Strategic Plan and to contribute to decision making processes.
* Provide technical inputs related to data collection and analysis for the monitoring and reporting processes of joint results achieved with UNDP, UNFPA and UNICEF.
* Provide strategic and technical support for the preparation of materials for all Executive Board formal and informal sessions, including presentations and briefing notes.

**Provide technical support to UN Women field offices and HQ units on data collection and analysis:**

* Provide technical support to HQ units and field offices to specify and improve methodologies for data collection and analysis per Strategic Plan indicator as well as Strategic Note/Work Plan and project levels to strengthened evidence\-based monitoring and reporting.
* Develop specific training materials and tools on statistics, data collection and analysis to strengthen capacity of UN Women personal in those areas.

**Provide technical contributions and guidance to evidence\-based communication on UN Women’s results and achievements and associated financial data with stakeholders and external partners:**

* Collect, aggregate and analyze both qualitative and quantitative and financial data on results from the field and HQ on UN Women Strategic Plans through results management systems of UN Women and beyond, and summarize, visualise and present key findings to be used for communication with key partners, donors and the public.
* Prepare visual presentation of results and associated financial data and UN Women’s performance for internal and external audiences.
* Contribute to communication of UN Women’s results linking with SDG goals, targets and indicators.

**Provide technical contributions to integration of data collection, analysis and results communication in UN Women business processes and procedures in the areas of strategic planning, monitoring, reporting and knowledge management:**

* Ensure that data collection, analysis and results communication are systematically integrated in programming\-related policies, procedures, guidance and tools of UN Women under Policies, Procedures and Guidance framework and support its rollout.

**Provide technical contributions to development and enhancement of UN Women IT systems to strengthen data collection, analysis and communication of results data:**

* Provide inputs to the specification of business cases and functional requirements specifically related to data collection, analysis, visualization of data, and results communication in the processes of development of new and/or enhancement of existing IT systems of UN Women
* Provide technical support in conducting User Acceptance Testing specifically those functionalities that support systematic data collection, analysis and results communication of UN Women Strategic Plan.

**Strengthen Transparency, Innovation, and Systems for Results Management and implementation of UN 2\.0:**

* Oversee the operations of UN Women’s Transparency Portal, ensuring it serves as a comprehensive and user\-friendly platform for accountability and results communication.
	+ Manages the presentation of annual reporting results and financial data against UN Women Strategic Plans and Strategic Notes on the Transparency Portal.
	+ Continuously enhance portal functionality to meet evolving organizational needs, including integrating advanced data analytics and visualization tools.
	+ Monitor and maintain data integrity, ensuring accurate, timely, and high\-quality content on the portal.
	+ Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, including Country Offices, Regional Offices, HQ Divisions, and partners, to ensure effective use and consistent updates to the Portal.
	+ Support implementation AI\-driven solutions to enhance the Transparency Portal’s functionality, including intelligent search capabilities and data quality improvements.
	+ Conduct technical training sessions to strengthen internal capacity in data\-driven approaches and the effective use of the Transparency Portal.
* Strengthen engagement with IATI and Reporting Standards:
	+ Drive improvements in IATI reporting to enhance transparency and compliance with international standards.
	+ Conduct capacity\-building sessions and manage working groups to increase awareness and technical capacity for IATI reporting across the organization.
	+ Actively engage with the IATI community to explore and implement best practices and innovative approaches.
* Leverage AI and Innovation for Results Management:
	+ Support Pilot AI/machine learning models to streamline data reporting and improve the accuracy and usability of results and financial data.
	+ Explore the use of innovation and big data for results monitoring and reporting and train UN Women personnel on relevant tools.
	+ Foster innovation by exploring emerging technologies to modernize data management and results reporting processes.
	+ Support and contribute to corporate initiatives to implement UN 2\.0 in UN Women, including development and roll\-out of UN Women’s strategy on UN 2\.0 especially on Organizational Effectiveness and Efficiency (OEE) side in close collaboration with relevant HQ Divisions.
	+ Support and contribute to inter\-agency initiatives around AI, innovation and data, including those through the UN Strategic Planning Network.

**Background**

The United Nations Volunteers (UNV) programme is the United Nations system\-wide service for volunteerism. Established by the General Assembly in 1970 and administered by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), UNV mobilizes qualified, motivated and diverse volunteers to support United Nations mandates in development, peace and security, human rights and humanitarian action, while promoting volunteerism as an important means of implementing the 2030 Agenda.


UNV works with organizations of the United Nations system, Member States, national and local institutions, civil society and communities. Its distinctive value lies in connecting the UN system with people and communities through volunteers, providing flexible talent and capacity solutions to UN entities while generating evidence, partnerships and policy support for volunteerism. The programme has evolved into a substantial global operation, with more than 17,000 UN Volunteers deployed in 172 countries in 2025, supported by close to 500 global personnel in UNV headquarters in Bonn, six regional offices and over sixty country presences and multi\-country field units.


The current strategic context requires UNV to consolidate previous expansion and relevance as the system\-wide service, while at the same time furthering its agility, efficiency, digital maturity, operational and financial resilience, and close alignment with the evolving needs of UN Country Teams and programme countries.  



**Duties and Responsibilities**

The Executive Coordinator reports to UNDP Administrator and leads UNV within the policy, strategic and institutional framework established by the UN General Assembly, the UNDP/UNFPA/UNOPS Executive Board, UNDP Strategic Plan and the UNV Strategic Framework. The position combines the responsibilities of executive leader, strategic manager, and principal advocate of UNV.


The Executive Coordinator provides the overall vision, strategic direction and executive leadership required to fulfill UNV’s mandate and to translate the policy direction of the General Assembly and Executive Board into organizational priorities, strategies and partnerships. The incumbent leads the mobilization and stewardship of human, financial, institutional and partnership resources; represents UNV with Member States, UN entities and external stakeholders; and ensures that the programme operates with integrity, efficiency, transparency, accountability and strong results orientation.


The Executive Coordinator ensures that UNV remains responsive to Member States and UN partners while maintaining a strong focus on volunteer quality, inclusion, duty of care and the experience of volunteers throughout the service cycle.


The Executive Coordinator leads UNV in a way that continuously modernizes its service offer and promotes the strategic relevance of volunteerism in the UN system and beyond. He/she is accountable for positioning UNV as a trusted, effective and innovative system\-wide service that enables the United Nations to draw on the skills, commitment and local knowledge of volunteers, while advancing recognition of volunteerism as a means of achieving peace and development.


In addition, the Executive Coordinator has delegated responsibility for coordinating daily management of common premises and common services for the organizations of the UN system at the UN Bonn campus, including related administrative, managerial and policy issues, as well as liaising with the Federal Government of Germany, the State Government of North Rhine\-Westphalia and the City Municipality of Bonn on such matters.


1\) Strategic leadership, planning and management


* Provide overall strategic leadership to UNV and translate General Assembly resolutions, Executive Board decisions, relevant UN system priorities and UNDP policies into organizational strategies, partnerships and practices.
* Lead the design and implementation of the UNV Strategic Frameworks, ensuring clear institutional priorities, implementation arrangements, measurable results, effective innovations and systematic monitoring of performance.
* Position UNV as an agile, fit\-for\-purpose and people\-centered UN system\-wide service, continuously adapting volunteer modalities, operating models and services to changing UN and country\-level needs. Leads the institution in a way that continuously modernizes its service offer.
* Promote decentralization and appropriate delegation of authority so that UNV can respond effectively to country and regional requirements while maintaining corporate standards and accountability.
* Foster an organizational culture based on integrity, innovation, collaboration, inclusion, learning and service to UN partners and volunteers.
* Ensure that organizational structures, policies, business processes, digital capabilities and workforce arrangements remain aligned with strategic objectives.
* Inform and consult UNDP Administrator and senior UNDP leadership and ensure that UNV's governance and management arrangements remain consistent with its status as a UNDP\-administered system\-wide service.

2\) External relations, representation and advocacy


* Serve as the principal spokesperson and representative of UNV with Member States, UN entities, civil society, academia, the private sector and other stakeholders. Contribute to intergovernmental dialogue on volunteerism, including follow\-up to relevant General Assembly resolutions, Secretary\-General reports, international observances and global policy processes. In doing so, demonstrates strong partnerships acumen and intuitional judgement.
* Advocate for volunteerism as a cross\-cutting means of implementation of the Sustainable Development Goals and as a contributor to peace and security, human rights and humanitarian action.
* Sustain high\-level partnerships for the integration of volunteerism into national plans and policies. Maintain strategic engagement with Resident Coordinators and UN Country Teams and promote the inclusion of volunteerism in Sustainable Development Cooperation Frameworks and country programming.
* Position UNV as a source of credible evidence, policy advice and innovation on volunteerism, including through research, data, knowledge products and global advocacy.
* Mobilize support for inclusive volunteerism, with particular attention to participation by women, young and older people, persons with disabilities, people from developing countries and other groups that may face barriers to participation.
* Strengthen UNV's public profile while ensuring communications are evidence\-based, consistent with UN values and focused on the contribution of volunteers to tangible results. Represent UNV at high\-level international forums and public events, communicating its mandate, results and strategic priorities with clarity and credibility.

3\) Results and resources management


* Ensure that UNV delivers the results approved by its governing bodies and that organizational performance is systematically measured, analyzed, communicated and used for decision\-making.
* Oversee the effective and transparent management of UNV's financial, human, digital and other resources, consistent with UNDP policies, UN rules and applicable accountability frameworks.
* Safeguard the financial sustainability of UNV, strengthen the resource base, diversifying strategic partnerships, and maintain appropriate balances between institutional resources and requirements.
* Provide strategic stewardship of the Special Voluntary Fund and other flexible resources, ensuring that they are deployed where they can respond to emergencies and/or generate catalytic and innovative high\-value impact.
* Oversee enterprise\-level risk management, internal controls, audit follow\-up and evaluation, ensuring that risks are identified early and addressed decisively.
* Strengthen data\-driven management, including the use of artificial intelligence, digital tools, analytics and evidence to improve organizational performance, decision\-making, cost\-effectiveness and efficiency gains.
* Report transparently on results, resources, risks and performance to the Executive Board, UNDP leadership, Member States and other relevant stakeholders.

4\) People, innovation and organizational effectiveness


* Champion the principle that UNV's central asset is its people: UN Volunteers, staff and the communities and partners with whom they work. Translates general duty of care commitments onto practical arrangements and initiatives.
* Ensure that volunteerism is delivered through high\-quality, safe, inclusive and meaningful assignments, with appropriate duty of care throughout the volunteer life cycle.
* Oversee continued modernization of volunteer management, including flexible, short\-term, part\-time, remote and other modalities responsive to the evolving needs of UN entities and programme countries.
* Ensure that innovation, digital transformation, automation and responsible use of data and emerging technologies improve service quality, accessibility, speed and efficiency.
* Encourage experimentation and learning while maintaining appropriate safeguards, ethical standards and accountability.
* Strengthen UNV's ability to identify emerging needs and rapidly adapt its operating model, particularly in fragile, conflict\-affected, humanitarian and crisis contexts.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement in which evidence from volunteers, host entities, programme countries, evaluations and operational experience informs policy and management decisions.
* Promote leadership development, collaboration across headquarters, regional and field structures, and a shared organizational identity centered on service, solidarity, professionalism and measurable impact.

**Pflichtpraktikum Content Creation / Video (m/w/d)**  
***Raum Köln \| Vollzeit \| 3–6 Monate \| Start flexibel***

Du hast keinen Bock auf ein 08/15\-Corporate\-Praktikum, bei dem du fünf Monate daneben sitzt, Kaffee holst und am Ende drei Canva\-Posts gemacht hast? Wir auch nicht. Saints Frères ist eine deutsch\-französisch inspirierte Streetwear\-Marke – Kleidung von der Straße für die Straße. Geprägt von französischem Rap, Fußball, Film und dem Leben in den Banlieues verbinden wir Streetwear mit Freundschaft, Loyalität und Zusammenhalt. Wir bauen unsere Marke selbst auf – von Kollektionen und Kampagnen bis zum Content.

**Was du bei uns machst:**

Bei uns schaust du nicht dabei zu, wie Content entsteht. Du produzierst ihn mit.

**IDEE → KONZEPT → KAMERA → SCHNITT → POST → REAKTION**

* Reels und TikToks drehen und schneiden
* Fashion\-, Produkt\- und Editorial\-Content produzieren
* Shootings begleiten und Behind\-the\-Scenes\-Content festhalten
* Interviews und eigene Formate produzieren
* Videoschnitt, Color Correction, Color Grading, Sound Design und Pacing
* Storyboards und Shotlists entwickeln; neue Content\- und Kampagnenideen einbringen
* Mit zunehmender Erfahrung eigene Content\-Projekte von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung mitverantworten

**Wen wir suchen** :

Das Praktikum baut auf vorhandenen Kamera\- und Schnittkenntnissen auf. Wir suchen keinen kompletten Anfänger.

* Erfahrung mit professionellen Systemkameras und manuellen Einstellungen (Blende, ISO, Verschlusszeit, Weißabgleich, Framerate, Fokus)
* Verständnis für Brennweiten, Bildkomposition, Licht und Kamerabewegung
* Erfahrung mit Video\-/Contentproduktionen
* Sicherer Umgang mit Adobe Premiere Pro oder DaVinci Resolve
* Eigenständiger Schnitt und Grundlagen in Color Correction und Color Grading
* Gutes Gefühl für Musik, Rhythmus, Sound, Pacing und Short\-Form\-Content
* Eigeninitiative, Zuverlässigkeit, Teamfähigkeit und sorgfältiger Umgang mit Equipment

Nur Handyvideos und CapCut reichen für diese Stelle nicht aus. Du musst nicht extrovertiert sein, solltest bei Produktionen aber gut mit anderen Beteiligten kommunizieren können.

**Equipment \& Postproduktion**  
Du arbeitest mit professionellem Kamera\- und Filmequipment, das dir von uns vollständig zur Verfügung gestellt wird. Dazu gehören unter anderem:

* **Sony Alpha 7 IV** mit Tamron 28–75 mm F/2\.8
* **DJI Osmo Pocket 3**
* **DJI Funkmikrofon\-System** für professionelle Audioaufnahmen
* **SmallRig Equipment und externer Kameramonitor**
* **SmallRig / externer Monitor, Stative und weiteres Kamera\-Zubehör**
* **Stative, Licht\- und weiteres Kamera\-Zubehör**
* **Analoge Filmkamera** für kreative und experimentelle Aufnahmen

Für Schnitt und Postproduktion arbeiten wir mit **DaVinci Resolve**. Zusätzlich erhältst du die Möglichkeit zum fachlichen Austausch und zur Zusammenarbeit mit einem externen professionellen Cutter.

**Du benötigst kein eigenes Kameraequipment.** Die gesamte Kamera\- und Tonausrüstung wird von uns gestellt. Voraussetzung ist lediglich ein eigener leistungsfähiger Laptop, mit dem du Schnitt\- und Kreativsoftware nutzen kannst.

**WAS DU BEI UNS BEKOMMST:**

* echte Kampagnen, Shootings und Contentproduktionen statt reiner Zuarbeit
* zunehmende Eigenverantwortung und eigene Content\-Projekte
* direkten Austausch mit den Gründern und einem professionellen Cutter
* Einblick in Markenaufbau, Kampagnenentwicklung, Social\-Media\-Storytelling und Content\-Performance
* geeignete veröffentlichte Arbeiten nach Absprache für dein Portfolio
* kostenlose Saints\-Frères\-Pieces aus den während des Praktikums erscheinenden Kollektionen
* Family\-\&\-Friends\-Rabatt, Verpflegung während regulärer Arbeitstage bzw. Produktionen und kostenloser Parkplatz

**ARBEITSALLTAG \& PRODUKTIONEN**

Das Praktikum ist grundsätzlich als Präsenzpraktikum im Creative Space / Studio im Raum Köln geplant. Dort finden Content\-Arbeit, Planung, Postproduktion und interne Produktionen statt. Homeoffice kann nach vorheriger Absprache für geeignete Aufgaben wie Schnitt oder Postproduktion möglich sein. Je nach Projekt bist du außerdem bei Shootings, Events und Produktionen außerhalb des regulären Arbeitsortes dabei. Auch Produktionen und Reisen im In\- und Ausland beispielsweise nach Paris, können projektabhängig Teil des Praktikums sein. Bei dienstlich veranlassten Reisen übernimmt Saints Frères die notwendigen Reise\- und Übernachtungskosten. Einzelne Produktionen können abends oder am Wochenende stattfinden. In diesem Fall wird die Arbeitszeit entsprechend organisiert und Freizeitausgleich berücksichtigt.

Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist uns deutlich weniger wichtig als zu sehen, was du tatsächlich kannst. Schick uns 3–5 deiner stärksten Arbeiten. Das können zum Beispiel Reels, TikToks, Fashion\-Filme, Musikvideos, Kurzfilme, Fotografien, Commercials, Uni\-Projekte, eigene Projekte, Edits oder Spec Ads sein. Die Arbeiten müssen nicht für große Kunden produziert worden sein. Uns interessiert dein Auge mehr als dein Lebenslauf.

Schick uns deine 3–5 Arbeitsproben / dein Portfolio und optional ein paar Sätze zu dir und warum du zu Saints Frères willst an bewerbung@saintsfreres.de

Arbeitsort: Zum Teil im Homeoffice in 50389 Wesseling

Die OVAG Oberbergische Verkehrsgesellschaft ist das kommunale Busunternehmen in Oberberg. Wir betreiben über 50 Linien mit insgesamt rund 200 Bussen und befördern etwa 16 Millionen Fahrgäste jährlich. Über 300 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter arbeiten in der Unternehmensgruppe, deren Eigentümer der Oberbergische Kreis und elf Städte und Gemeinden aus der Region sind.
 



 Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir am Standort Gummersbach einen:
 



**Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) in der Leitstelle** 




 Als Mitarbeiter in unserer Leitstelle sind Sie zentraler Ansprechpartner für einen reibungslosen Betriebsablauf, reagieren souverän auf Störungen, organisieren Ersatzmaßnahmen, unterstützen das Fahrpersonal, halten relevante Informationen aktuell und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Betriebsleitstelle.
 


  

**Aufgaben** 
  

* Regelung des Betriebsablaufs
* Überwachung und Koordinierung der Ausfahrten
* Kurzfristige Disposition der Fahrzeuge sowie des Personals
* Selbstständige Organisation und Bestellung von verkehrlichen Ersatzmaßnahmen bei kurzfristigen Streckensperrungen, Busausfällen und technischen Störungen
* Durchführung von Maßnahmen bei Unregelmäßigkeiten oder Störungen im Betriebsablauf
* Dokumentation des Betriebsablaufs
* Pflege und Überwachung von Fahrgastinformationsmedien
* Mitwirkung bei der Weiterentwicklung der Betriebsleitstelle
* Regelmäßige Einsätze im Außendienst für die Sicherstellung der Betriebssicherheit und des Betriebsablaufs
* Übernahme von Sonderaufgaben
  


**Profil**
* Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zur Fachkraft im Fahrbetrieb oder ein vergleichbarer Abschluss,
   

 alternativ mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Fahrdienst
* Besitz der Führerscheinklasse D/DE, inklusive gültiger Fahrerqualifikation
* Sehr gute Orts\- und Streckenkenntnisse im Bereich des Bediengebietes der OVAG
* Ausbildung zum Verkehrsmeister (VDV) von Vorteil oder die Bereitschaft die Qualifikation zeitnah nachzuholen
* Kenntnisse in relevanten Leitstellensystemen (z.B. ITCS, Nettropolis) oder die Bereitschaft, sich diese anzueignen
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel, Word und Outlook
* Bereitschaft zum Wechselschichtdienst
* Durchsetzungsvermögen sowie eine selbständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikations\- und Teamfähigkeit
* Hohes Maß an Leistungsbereitschaft, Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität
* Bereitschaft und Offenheit, sich mit neuen Systemen und Technologien auseinanderzusetzen


  

**Wir bieten**
* Ein faires tarifliches Entgelt sowie Jahressonderzahlungen
* Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
* Ein vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket
* Rabatte für Beschäftigte
* Jobradleasing
* Vergünstigte Konditionen in unseren Partner\-Sportstudios
* Eine Unternehmenskultur, die durch Vielfalt und kollegiales Miteinander geprägt ist

Über uns
   

  

 In den vergangenen Jahrzehnten haben wir uns mit unseren Produkten für Fahrwerk, Karosserie und Antrieb zu einem Top\-Automobilzulieferer entwickelt. Mit neuen Leichtbauprodukten, Werkstoffen und Fertigungstechnologien bieten wir in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden und wissenschaftlichen Institutionen innovative Lösungen für leichtere Fahrzeuge. Wir schaffen bahnbrechende Neuerungen und setzen damit internationale Standards. Als inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen mit hoher Flexibilität, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer langfristig ausgerichteten Strategie beschäftigen wir weltweit mehr als 17\.200 Mitarbeiter an 70 Standorten in über 20 Ländern. Zum TT.MM. möchten wir mit Dir die Ausbildung als ... am Standort ... starten.
   

  

 Das ist Dein Beruf
   

  

 Du stellst die komplette Energieversorgung an allen benötigten Stellen in unserem Unternehmen sicher \- ob im Büro, an der Werkbank oder an den Produktionsmaschinen. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören die Installation, Wartung und Reparatur von elektrischen Betriebs\-, Produktions\- und Verfahrensanlagen, von Schalt\- und Steueranlagen über Anlagen der Energieversorgung bis zu Einrichtungen der Kommunikations\- und Beleuchtungstechnik. Du bist geschult im Umgang mit Programmiersoftware und PC\-Systemen.
   

  

 Das alles lernst Du bei uns in 3 Jahren\*
   

  

* Betriebliche und technische Kommunikation
* Planen und Organisieren der Arbeit, Bewerten der Arbeitsergebnisse
* Montieren und Anschließen elektrischer Betriebsmittel
* Messen und Analysieren von elektrischen Funktionen und Systemen
* Beurteilen der Sicherheit von elektrischen Anlagen und Betriebsmitteln
* Installieren und Konfigurieren von IT\-Systemen
* Technische Auftragsanalyse, Lösungsentwicklung
* Installieren und Inbetriebnehmen von elektrischen Anlagen
* Konfigurieren und Programmieren von Steuerungen
* Instandhalten von Anlagen und Systemen
* Technischer Service und Betrieb
* Berufsbildung, Arbeits\- und Tarifrecht
* Aufbau und Organisation des Ausbildungsbetriebes
* Sicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz \*Bei besonders guten Leistungen steigst Du bereits nach 3 Jahren voll in das Berufsleben ein.


 Das wünschen wir uns von Dir
   

  

* Gute Mittlere Reife oder Abitur
* Erste Erfahrungen, z.B. durch Praktika
* Interesse an Theorie und Praxis
* Logisches und technisches Verständnis
* Teamfähigkeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Einsatzbereitschaft
* Präzises Arbeiten
* Gute Konzentrationsfähigkeit
* Internationale Flexibilität


 Unser Angebot
   

  

 Bei Mubea bieten wir Dir einen begleiteten und sicheren Einstieg mit abwechslungsreichen und verantwortungsvollen Aufgaben. Starte Deine berufliche Zukunft mit unserem zertifizierten Ausbildungsprogramm, werde Teil unserer Mubea\-Familie und finde gemeinsam mit uns heraus, wie Deine berufliche Zukunft bei uns aussehen kann. Gehe Deinen Weg mit Mubea! Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

**Our team and mission**
------------------------


Within the Exploration Science Office of the Directorate of Human and Robotic Exploration, the Human Exploration Science Team (HRE\-SH) conducts research that enables future human space exploration while leveraging spaceflight and analogue platforms to advance knowledge and improve human health on Earth. HRE\-SH uses a wide range of terrestrial and (sub\-) orbital research platforms, as well as the International Space Station (ISS), to investigate the effects of selected or combined spaceflight stressors on human health and performance. These platforms include parabolic flight, dry immersion, bed rest, isolated and confined environments, and spaceflight. This work focuses on the identification and mitigation of challenges to astronaut health and performance to enable the safe exploration of European Astronauts to low\-Earth orbit, the Moon, and beyond. Furthermore, by leveraging the platforms developed for exploration, scientific experiments can be conducted under unique conditions, generating benefits on Earth in fields such as healthcare, ageing research, and health management. HRE\-SH works closely with international partners, astronauts, medical support, and the scientific community to define and address operational needs and scientific priorities.

  

Candidates interested are encouraged to visit the ESA website: http://www.esa.int


**Field(s) of activity for the internship**
-------------------------------------------

  

**Background**


Although upper extremity venous thrombosis also occurs on Earth, spaceflight conditions may increase its likelihood and make it a serious medical risk. Microgravity redistributes body fluids and can reduce or reverse venous blood flow, particularly in the head and neck, promoting venous stasis \- one of the main mechanisms of thrombus formation. Managing this risk will become increasingly important during exploration missions, where constraints on mass, volume, crew time, medical expertise, and communication with Earth will limit available countermeasures. Several preventive approaches may modify venous flow or other contributors to thrombosis, but their evidence, safety, operational suitability, and readiness for in\-flight use have not been assessed within a common framework. This internship will address this gap by reviewing evidence from ESA research platforms and relevant terrestrial clinical contexts to identify and prioritise countermeasures that could be safely and realistically implemented during spaceflight.

  

  

**Aim**


Based on a structured review of the available literature, you will assess candidate countermeasures according to their physiological mechanism, evidence of efficacy and safety, operational feasibility, and technology maturity. The findings will inform adjustments to scientific and operational priorities and roadmaps, support the translation of evidence into operational and technology requirements, and identify priorities for further validation.

  

  

**Main activities**


* conduct a structured review of relevant spaceflight, analogue, terrestrial clinical, and technology\-development evidence;
* evaluate candidate approaches, including lower body negative pressure, venous thigh cuffs, modifications to existing exercise protocols, simple neck\-flow interventions, respiratory or positional manoeuvres, and compact compression technologies;
* develop structured comparison tables to assess the evidence, safety, technology maturity, and operational feasibility of each countermeasure for future exploration missions;
* create a safety and decision framework separating routine prevention, use with abnormal flow or suspected thrombosis, and use after confirmed thrombosis;
* identify promising emerging technologies, rank the most suitable approaches using pre\-defined criteria, and propose a validation study for the highest\-priority option.
  

  

**Expected outputs**


The primary outputs will be an internal report documenting the literature\-review methods, findings, and recommendations; evidence and technology\-readiness matrices; a safety and decision framework; a prioritised shortlist; a validation\-study concept; and concrete recommendations for updating ESA priorities and the venous thrombosis roadmap and for defining operational and technology requirements. Subject to the maturity and scientific novelty of the work, you will also prepare a manuscript for submission to a peer\-reviewed journal.

  

  

**Learning objectives**


Through this internship, you will gain experience in systematic evidence synthesis, health\-technology assessment, technology\-readiness evaluation, risk–benefit analysis, human spaceflight operations, scientific writing, and translation of research evidence into practical recommendations for astronaut health.

**Our team and mission**
------------------------


The Robotics \& IoT Lab at the European Astronaut Centre focuses on advancing robotic systems and human–robot interaction in support of space exploration. Our work spans robotic autonomy, AI\-supported decision\-making, and XR\-enabled control concepts.

  

This internship addresses humanoid robotics in environments relevant to exploration: locomotion on uneven terrain in our lunar analogue facility, operation under extreme conditions like the lunar south pole, and collaboration with humans in shared workspaces. A particular focus is exploring XR\-based teleoperation and supervision of humanoid robots, including predictive simulation approaches that compensate for pronounced communication delays in off\-Earth scenarios. Additionally, a key objective is to integrate modern AI methods into control and decision\-making, enabling humanoid robots to adapt to unpredictable environments and support astronauts more effectively.

  

The project contributes to ESA’s efforts to bridge human presence, robotic autonomy, and immersive control systems, strengthening Europe’s expertise in humanoid robotics and human–robot teaming for future exploration missions.

  

Candidates interested are encouraged to visit the ESA website: http://www.esa.int

You will work directly with a humanoid robot platform and support the development of control and interaction concepts in exploration\-relevant scenarios.

* programming locomotion and balance behaviours for humanoid robots on uneven terrain;
* developing strategies for robot operation under constrained conditions (e.g. extreme lighting at the lunar south pole);
* exploring XR\-based teleoperation and supervisory control, enabling intuitive interfaces for astronauts and operators;
* exploring how AI techniques such as reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and predictive models can be applied to locomotion, teleoperation, and human–robot interaction;
* investigating predictive simulation and state estimation approaches to mitigate the effects of communication latency in off\-Earth teleoperation;
* contributing to methods for human–robot interaction in shared tasks, including safety and usability considerations, using AI and traditional approaches;
* supporting simulation, benchmarking, and hardware validation of behaviours and interaction methods.

* gain experience in humanoid robotics hardware, locomotion, and control stacks;
* understand the challenges of XR\-based teleoperation with communication latency in off\-Earth contexts;

Result of Service
A fully developed proposal for the conservation of one or multiple species of gorillas ready for submission to a specific and appropriate donor or donors.
Work Location
Remote
Expected duration
6 months
Duties and Responsibilities
The Convention on the Conservation of Migratory Species of Wild Animals (CMS) is a global intergovernmental treaty aimed at the conservation and sustainable use of migratory species and their habitats. Numerous additional intergovernmental instruments on migratory species conservation have been adopted under the broad umbrella of CMS which are supported by the CMS Secretariat. In addition, two regional agreements on migratory species adopted under CMS have their own Secretariats which are co\-located with the CMS Secretariat in Bonn \- the Agreement on the Conservation of African\-Eurasian Migratory Waterbirds (AEWA) and the Agreement on the Conservation of European Populations of Bats (EUROBATS). The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is the United Nations system's designated entity for addressing environmental issues at the global and regional level. Its mandate is to coordinate the development of environmental policy consensus by keeping the global environment under review and bringing emerging issues to the attention of governments and the international community for action. In the present context, UNEP provides the administrative functions for the CMS, AEWA and EUROBATS Secretariats. Overall responsibility for this consultancy lies with Mr. Andrew Raine, Executive Secretary of the CMS Secretariat. The consultant will work under the direct supervision of Ms. Clara Nobbe, Head of the Terrestrial Species Team, and Mr. Nathan Mesnildrey, Associate Programme Management Officer. The individual contractor will be responsible for performing the following duties, as required: The Convention on the Conservation of Migratory Species of Wild Animals (CMS) is the only global agreement that focuses on the conservation and sustainable use of migratory species and their habitats. Achieving the mandate of CMS is closely tied to addressing global drivers of biodiversity loss and environmental change, as well as in advancing targeted conservation solutions while addressing cross\-cutting threats to migratory species and their habitats. Priority areas for action include: 1\. area\-based conservation measures and species management approaches that integrate ecological connectivity, climate change and other relevant considerations; 2\. addressing overexploitation of species (e.g., illegal or unsustainable killing of species, including for domestic sales and other uses, and bycatch of non\-target species); 3\. minimizing the impacts of linear, energy and other infrastructure; and 4\. reducing impacts from pollution such as pesticides, plastics, lead, light and noise. Gorilla Agreement The Agreement on the Conservation of Gorillas and Their Habitats is a legally binding Agreement concluded under CMS. It provides a framework for coordinated conservation action for gorillas and their habitats across the ten gorilla Range States: Angola, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Congo, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Equatorial Guinea, Gabon, Nigeria, Rwanda and Uganda. The Agreement has been in force since November 2008 and is administered by the CMS Secretariat on an interim basis. It works closely with the UNEP Great Apes Survival Partnership (GRASP), as well as other partners, including CITES and the Primate Specialist Group of the IUCN Species Survival Commission. The Agreement covers the Western Gorilla and Eastern Gorilla, including their four subspecies, all of which are listed on Appendix I of CMS. Implementation is guided by subspecies\-specific Action Plans, developed and coordinated by the IUCN Species Survival Commission Primate Specialist Group, and focuses on priorities such as habitat protection and connectivity, population monitoring, law enforcement, wildlife health, sustainable livelihoods and transboundary cooperation. At its Fourth Meeting, held in Paris in December 2023, the Meeting of the Parties adopted Resolution 4\.2 on the Budget and Programme of Work for 2024 to 2026\. The Resolution notes that implementation of the Agreement is expected to be supported through Parties’ contributions, voluntary donor contributions and other appropriate mechanisms, and recalls the need to develop sustainable fundraising mechanisms.
Qualifications/special skills
An advanced university degree in natural resource management, conservation, biology, primatology, ecology or environmental sciences is required. A first level university degree in combination with qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced degree. A minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in developing successful funding proposals is required. Proven experience in natural resource management or conservation, with a particular focus on Central Africa and gorillas is required. Demonstrated expertise in project financing, funding management, and in the conceptualization and establishment of environmental projects is required. **Your role**
-------------


The exploitation of observations sits at the core of ECMWF’s global forecasting and environmental services. They are used to generate initial conditions for accurate forecasts of weather and atmospheric composition, the latter as part of the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS).


We are seeking a Scientist to enhance our exploitation of in\-situ observations. You will contribute to observation quality evaluation, assimilation methodology development, and seek to enhance our systems with Machine Learning techniques. You will play a key role in advancing ECMWF’s operational forecasting systems and contribute to research projects (JOHN and IM4CA) under the Horizon Europe EU framework.

**About the Active Sensing Team**
---------------------------------


This role is in the Active Sensing Team of the Earth System Assimilation Section, part of ECMWF’s Research Department. It has responsibility for the exploitation of in\-situ (surface\-based, aircraft, balloon) measurements and active satellite systems (RADAR and GNSS). In this particular role, the successful candidate will also work closely with colleagues specializing in atmospheric composition, data assimilation, machine learning and operational evaluation.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------


You will:

* Work closely with the Observations team in the Forecast \& Services Department to establish the real\-time observation ingest and data flow for new observation streams, both for meteorological parameters and atmospheric composition, particularly for greenhouse gases in the framework of the JOHN and IM4CA projects
* Adapt the existing ECMWF systems to make additional use of these new observations in a research context and evaluate the impact on analyses and forecasts
* Where appropriate, migrate observations from research use to deployment in ECMWF’s operational systems used to produce weather and atmospheric composition predictions

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------


We are looking for someone who brings solid scientific expertise with the assimilation of observations in Earth system prediction systems. You understand data assimilation principles and have the technical expertise needed to contribute to advancing our operational forecasting systems.


You will bring:

* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to connect theoretical understanding with practical data assimilation development
* A rigorous and proactive approach to improving methods and code
* An ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues across different areas, supported by clear communication skills
* Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high\-quality work when timelines are constrained
* An ability to efficiently document your work

**Your profile**
----------------

**Education**

* An advanced university degree, or equivalent professional experience, in a relevant field

**Essential Experience and Knowledge**

* Demonstrated experience with atmospheric data assimilation methodologies, such as variational methods, Kalman Filters, or data driven machine learning approaches
* A broad understanding of satellite and in\-situ observations of the atmosphere
* Experience working with and maintaining large collaborative scientific codes, as well as agentic coding tools

**Desirable Experience and Knowledge**

* Experience with NWP and / or atmospheric composition data assimilation
* Experience coding and conducting experiments in high\-performance computing environments
* Knowledge of tools and processes for software management and software quality


Candidates **must** be able to work effectively in English. A good knowledge of one of the Centre’s other working languages (French or German) is an advantage.

*If you feel that you have the motivation and many of the skills for this role but don't meet precisely all of the criteria listed above, we still encourage you to apply.*

**About the projects**
----------------------

**The IM4CA project**  

IM4CA (https://im4ca.eu/) is a large Horizon Europe project with 27 partners focused on improving our understanding of regional and global sources and sinks of atmospheric methane in the past, present, and future. ECMWF’s role is to use the knowledge and datasets on methane sources and sinks that become available during the project to improve the representation of methane in the operational CAMS greenhouse gas services.

**The JOHN project**  

The JOHN (https://john\-project.eu/) project will support the implementation of WMO’s Global Greenhouse Gas Watch (G3W) by assessing and improving the global greenhouse gas observing system, exploring emerging technologies, and developing priorities for future investment and monitoring. One of ECMWF’s roles is to adapt the CAMS data assimilation system to allow for the assimilation of in situ observations of atmospheric composition species. The exploitation of radiocarbon observations in the IFS \- with focus on Europe \- will also be assessed.

**Copernicus and CAMS**  

Copernicus is the flagship Earth observation component of the European Union (EU) space programme. Based on the exploitation of space\-based and Earth observations and scientific models, Copernicus provides validated information services for land, marine, atmosphere and climate monitoring, as well as emergency management and security. These services, and their free, open and quality\-assured data and tools, support a range of environmental and security applications across sectors and policy domains. ECMWF has been entrusted to operate two of these Services \- the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) and the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) \- on behalf of the European Commission, as well as being a contributor to the Copernicus Emergency Management Service.  

The Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) service provides consistent and quality\-controlled information related to atmospheric composition, including air pollutants and greenhouse gases, solar energy, and climate forcing, everywhere in the world. For more information, see: https://www.copernicus.eu/en/copernicus\-services/atmosphere

**About ECMWF**
---------------


The **European Centre for Medium\-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF)** is a world leader in Numerical Weather Predictions providing high\-quality data for weather forecasts and environmental monitoring. As an intergovernmental organisation we collaborate internationally to serve our members and the wider community with global weather predictions, data and training activities that are critical to contribute to safe and thriving societies.


The success of our activities depends on the funding and partnerships of our 35 Member and Co\-operating States who provide the support and direction of our work. Our talented staff together with the international scientific community, and our powerful supercomputing capabilities,are the core of a 24/7 research and operational centre with a focus on medium and long\-range predictions. We also hold one of the largest meteorological data archives in the world.

**Our vision**: World\-leading monitoring and predictions of the Earth system enabled by cutting\-edge physical, computational and data science, resulting from a close collaboration between ECMWF and the members of the European Meteorological Infrastructure, will contribute to a safe and thriving society

**Our mission**: Deliver global numerical weather predictions focusing on the medium\-range and monitoring of the Earth system to and with our Member States


In addition, ECMWF has established a strong partnership with the European Union and has been entrusted with the implementation and operation of the **Destination Earth** initiative and the Climate Change and Atmosphere Monitoring Services of the **Copernicus Programme**, as well as being a contributor to the Copernicus Emergency Management Service. Other areas of work include High Performance Computing and the development of digital tools that enable ECMWF to extend provision of data and products covering weather, climate, air quality, fire and flood prediction and monitoring.


ECMWF is a multi\-site organisation, with its headquartersin Reading, UK, a data centre in Bologna, Italy, and a large presence in Bonn, Germany as a central location for our EU\-related activities.ECMWF is internationally recognised as the voice of expertise in numerical weather predictions for forecasts and climate science.

---------------------

**Grade remuneration:** The successful candidates will be recruited according to the scales of the Co\-ordinated Organisations. In addition to basic salary, ECMWF also offers an attractive benefits package. Information about working with us and full details of salary scales and allowances are available on the ECMWF website at: www.ecmwf.int/en/about/jobs/working\-ecmwf.

We value the benefits derived from a diverse workforce and are committed to having staff that reflect the diversity of the countries that are part of our community, in an environment that nurtures equality and inclusion.

As a successful candidate you will develop algorithms and models to investigate cancer evolution and chromosomal instability. You will be part of CLONETRAC, a collaborative consortium with the aim of tracking the clonal dynamics of cancer through treatment at the single\-cell level, funded by the Bruno and Helene Jöster Foundation. You will be embedded in a thriving interdisciplinary and collaborative team of computational biologists, computer scientists and clinicians at the University Hospital of Cologne.
